source.title: You Asked: How Do I Make Streetwear Smart? (MR PORTER)

tips.text: A plain hoodie can go under a smart jacket, overcoat or blazer to make a streetwear look sharper, especially when it's cool.
tips.why: Layering a casual hoodie under tailoring works in practice.

tips.text: For layering under tailoring, pick a hoodie with few or no logos in a mid-weight jersey, so it sits flat under the jacket.
tips.why: Bulky or loud hoodies ruin the line of a jacket.

tips.text: To make a streetwear outfit sharper, swap the jeans for trousers, ideally navy.
tips.why: Trousers raise the polish while the rest stays relaxed.

tips.text: When dressing streetwear up, choose minimal sneakers over chunky trainers.
tips.why: Chunky shoes pull attention from the rest.

tips.text: Mixing workwear, tailoring and streetwear is fine now, but do it deliberately: piece by piece, not just sneakers thrown on with formal clothes.
tips.why: Hybrid looks need thought to work.

outfits.outfit: jacket grey smart casual +workwear, shirt white smart casual +grandad-collar, trousers navy smart, sneakers white minimal
outfits.why: Workwear jacket and navy trousers sharpen a streetwear base.

outfits.outfit: coat navy smart, hoodie grey minimal, trousers navy smart casual, sneakers white minimal
outfits.why: A plain hoodie under a smart coat with trousers and clean sneakers.
